name: mediagen
description: OpenAI-compatible media generation service with a local web console.

scripts.build: npm run build:console && cargo build --release -p mediagen-server -p mediagen-local-launcher
scripts.lint: node scripts/check-code-line-limit.mjs --scope app --max 500 && node scripts/check-import-boundaries.mjs && node scripts/check-rust-platform-boundaries.mjs && npm --workspace @mediagen/console run lint
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run type-check && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run coverage:gate && npm run build && npm run cargo-fmt && npm run cargo-clippy && npm run cargo-test && npm run cargo-check && npm run check:compat-expiry
